home.title: Custom AI solutions for your operations | NODINA
home.description: NODINA designs and builds AI solutions connected to your data and software. Entrust us with delivery or strengthen your engineering team.
home.label: Custom AI solutions
home.heading: AI connected to your operations.
home.lead: We design and build solutions connected to your data and software, to automate the tasks that slow your business down.
home.problemsTitle: A process to improve. A system to build.
problems: Information to extract, check and move from one document to another.
Answers to find across sources, with references and the right access permissions.
Operations to connect across your software, with checks at important steps.
home.offersTitle: A solution to deliver. Or a team to strengthen.
home.systemsBody: You bring a business need. We scope, build and integrate the system into your environment.
home.teamsBody: You lead your product. We bring together senior engineers and coordinate their collaboration with your team.
home.proofBody: Jean-David Collard, NODINA’s founder, brings more than fifteen years of experience in products, hiring and management, alongside a PhD in computer science. That experience guides project scoping and team composition.
home.methodTitle: From the problem to an integrated system.
steps: Define the need, assess existing tools and agree on success criteria.
Develop components and integrations, then evaluate the result against your use case.
Prepare deployment and handover. Define responsibilities and the agreed follow-up.
home.closing: Which process do you want to improve?
home.closingBody: Let’s discuss your needs, your tools and what the solution should make possible.

systems.title: Custom AI development and integration | NODINA
systems.description: Document processing, knowledge search and connected workflows: NODINA scopes, builds and integrates your custom AI solution.
systems.label: Custom AI solutions
systems.heading: Your business need. An integrated AI solution.
systems.context: A manual process takes too much time. Or an AI use case remains an experiment.
systems.lead: Your data, software and constraints need to work together for a system to become part of daily operations. NODINA handles scoping, development and integration within the agreed scope.
systems.casesTitle: Start with a specific use case.
cases: Extract and structure information, verify results and send data to your business tools.
Search your sources with referenced answers and access suited to each user.
Orchestrate actions across software while keeping human checkpoints.
systems.examplesNote: Examples of possible systems, to be scoped around your data and constraints. AI can also be integrated into an existing product.
deliverables: Target use case, data, constraints and success criteria. Custom development is chosen when an existing tool is insufficient.
Code, integrations, tests and evaluations against your use cases. Engineering decisions are documented.
Deployment, documentation and handover. Operations, maintenance and responsibilities are defined in the proposal.
systems.fitTitle: A project grounded in your organization.
systems.fitBody: Together, we clarify the cost of the problem, the expected outcome and an initial scope. We review available data, access and constraints with the people involved.
fitPoints: Data and tools accessible within an agreed framework
Criteria to evaluate the solution’s value
systems.closingBody: Describe what is getting in the way and what you want to make possible. We’ll discuss project fit and next steps.
systems.alternative: Want to keep control of development?

teams.title: AI-native Teams: your senior engineering team | NODINA
teams.description: Strengthen your delivery capacity with senior engineers selected by NODINA, working in your tools, toward your priorities and alongside your team.
teams.label: AI-native Teams
teams.heading: Your roadmap. The engineers to move it forward.
teams.context: Your product is moving forward, but your team needs more capacity or a senior skill.
teams.lead: NODINA builds a team around your needs and coordinates its integration into your project. You keep control of priorities; engineers work in your code and tools, with an evaluated approach to AI.
teams.scopeTitle: Targeted reinforcement or a dedicated team.
scope: Software and product engineering skills matched to your project.
Profiles for AI systems, integrations and evaluation, depending on the scope.
Architecture or technical leadership to support your team.
teams.selectionBody: Code, command of AI tools and teamwork are assessed by experienced CTOs and lead developers. We select talent in Europe and Latin America around each project’s needs.
teams.workingTitle: A team integrated into the way you work.
working: Engineers work in your repositories and join your rituals. Responsibilities are defined together.
Team composition, pace, duration and terms are set out in the proposal. No equity stake or recruitment fees.
Code review, documentation and context sharing. Handover arrangements are scoped from the start.
teams.note: Team composition and start dates depend on the required skills and actual availability.
teams.closingBody: Let’s discuss your product, your current team and the next steps on your roadmap.
teams.alternative: Prefer to entrust us with system delivery?

footer: Custom AI solutions and senior engineering teams.
